svg.text: MPX SPIN V1.1 · TRIZ, FMEA, TEARDOWN, SOURCING

text.tspan: Fifteen parts. Item numbers match the BOM. The vane insert is gone (welded into item 8) and the floor gasket (9) and lid lock (2) are new.
